description: RabbitMQ behavior only a real broker shows (Testcontainers, Docker required): connection recovery and the size limit at the boundary.

mutants.name: a body exactly at the limit is rejected
deserialization failures are retried instead of dead-lettered
mutants.find: return await DeadLetterAsync(actions, activity, context.MessageId, new DeadLetterReason(DeadLetterReasons.DeserializationFailed, TypeName(ex)));
mutants.replace: return await RetryOrDeadLetterAsync(actions, activity, context, ex, stopping);
